title: Head-position bounds
statement: For natural numbers $d,C,q$, an optional control state indexed by $d,C$, and integer work-head positions $h_j$ for $j=0,\ldots,d$, define the predicate that constrains these positions as follows. If the state is absent, require $-1\le h_j\le q$ for every $j$. In loop state $i$, require $0\le h_j\le q$ for every $j$, and $h_j<q$ whenever $j\ne i$; in rewind state $i$, require $-1\le h_j<q$ for every $j$, and $h_j\ge0$ whenever $j\ne i$. In advance or emit states, require $0\le h_j<q$ for every $j$; in all other states the predicate is false.
hypotheses_covered: The state is either absent or a control state indexed by $d,C$
